subject: english
question: Choose the correct meaning of idiom: **Whistle in the dark**

options.text: Put on a brave front despite fear

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "Put on a brave front despite fear". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Whistle in the dark"** refers to pretending to be confident or putting on a brave front despite fear or uncertainty. (डर या अनिश्चितता के बावजूद साहसी दिखना) • **Example:** He was nervous about the exam results but tried to whistle in the dark by acting cheerful in front of his friends. • The correct meaning of the idiom is **"Put on a brave front despite fear"**. (डर के बावजूद साहसी दिखने का प्रयास करना) • **Example:** Even though she was scared of the surgery, she whistled in the dark to comfort her family. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Speak without clarity** (स्पष्टता के बिना बोलना): Refers to speaking in a vague or unclear manner. • **Example:** His presentation lacked preparation, and he spoke without clarity. • **Option 3: Refuse to take sides** (पक्ष लेने से मना करना): Refers to staying neutral in a situation or conflict. • **Example:** She refused to take sides in the argument between her two best friends. • **Option 4: Enjoy loneliness** (अकेलेपन का आनंद लेना): Refers to finding pleasure in being alone or spending time with oneself. • **Example:** He enjoys loneliness and often goes on solo trips to relax. 37:T9ee, The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
